This message comes from Kachava. A little boost goes a long way, especially when it comes to caring for your gut during the holiday season and beyond.
Introducing Kachava's new 3-in-1 digestive boost. Simply mix into your favorite Kachava shake or any cold beverage.
Go to kachava.com and use code NPR for 15% off your first order. That's K-A-C-H-A-V-A.com. Code NPR.
Live from NPR News in Washington, I'm Amy Held. The head of the FAA said U.S. air travel should fully recover by the end of the day.
But cancellations and delays are growing, topping 4,000 so far today. Federal officials say Friday's national ground stop started with faulty contractor work on a telecommunication line.
And blamed Congress for failing to provide funding for upgrades. Two days later, President Trump publicly weighed in for the first time.
Posting today that Congress must approve "desperately needed money." The Republican-led Congress has approved $12.5 billion for FAA upgrades.
Democrats say only $1 billion of that has been spent. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy spoke to CNN this morning.
We are on track to have all of that $12.5 billion spent and deployed by the end of 2028. But I have no money in that $12.5 billion that I can use for a new architecture for telecom.
I can't build new software to manage our airplanes in the airspace because it dates back to the 1990s, but there's no money for that. There's no money for towers. Our towers are old.
Duffy is asking Congress for $50 billion for upgrades. The alleged Chinese spy linked to the former Nvidia head is no longer with her company Megaspeed. NPR's Ava Pukach reports.
In a statement to NPR, Megaspeed said Alice Wong, who was an executive with the company, officially left Megaspeed effective August 30, 2025 and currently has no role with the company.
The company says a quote does not comment on Ms. Wong's personal and private matters. The New York Times reported that U.S. intelligence officials believe Alice Wong to be a Chinese spy. NPR has not independently confirmed that reporting.
Jensen Wong stepped down from his role at Nvidia following the New York Times reporting on his extramarital affairs. Megaspeed is a major buyer of advanced chips from Nvidia.
Megaspeed says it is reviewing the reporting and will communicate further with its stakeholders as appropriate. Ava Pukach, NPR News.
At Starbase, Texas, the crowds went wild witnessing history at the homecoming of a SpaceX Starship safely returned to its launch pad from 22 hours in orbit. NPR's Jeff Brumfield reports.
Starship reentered Earth's atmosphere and swooped over the Baja Peninsula across Texas to the same pad it took off from on the Gulf Coast. Starship burst through low clouds and then lowered itself onto the pad where it was grabbed by giant mechanical arms.
I still can't believe what we just saw. That was insane. That was wild. Picture perfect. The landing is a major breakthrough for SpaceX, which seeks to one day make Starship a rapidly reusable rocket. Jeff Brumfield, NPR News.
This is NPR News. Mid November means early winter already for parts of the U.S., Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia, and the Carolinas all came under freeze warnings this morning with lows dipping into the twenties farther west where atmospheric rivers have brought flood risk.
More rain is forecast to spread inland through California in higher elevations. That means more snow. Central New York Friday got a foot of snow. Democrats gathered in Denver for a conference that was half victory party after the midterm.
Half look ahead at how to deliver. NPR's Barbara Sprunt reports the event brought together rising stars, organizers, and lawmakers.
Speaker after speaker said Democrats can't rest on their laurels. Here's former transportation secretary Pete Buttigieg.
It is yet to be written whether what we just experienced is one more oscillation from one side to the other and back or whether it is the beginning of a tectonic movement changing American politics.
He said Democrats should come out of the gate strong with a rapid fire series of bills to lower the cost of living. He was one of many potential presidential candidates in attendance, all of whom said they're taking their time to decide before officially throwing their hat in the ring. Barbara Sprunt, NPR News, Denver.
Pope Leo traverses the length of Peru today, starting in Chiclayo, where he was once bishop, ending the day in Lima, before returning to Rome tomorrow. Leo, who hails from Chicago, is the first Peruvian citizen to become pope.
On his 12-day Three Nation South American tour, he has drawn the largest crowds of his papacy that some 12 million people, church officials say. This is NPR News.
This message comes from VCU. At Virginia Commonwealth University, research isn't simply an academic pursuit. It's knowledge put to work. VCU scholars and researchers are expanding what's known and what's possible across health, science, engineering, the arts, and more.
It's the kind of work that places VCU among the nation's top 50 public research universities. Virginia Commonwealth University, a world unlike any other. Learn more at vcu.edu.
